MeshOptimiser v0.27.1

A zip straight from GitHub. Free, open source, MIT. Windows and macOS.

Download .zip Open Lite View on GitHub What is new in v0.27.1

Get started

Unzip, start, drop a file.

  1. 01

    Download and unzip

    Unpack it anywhere. No installer: everything lives in that folder.

  2. 02

    Start it

    The first run sets itself up, then opens the viewer. After that it starts in about a second.

  3. 03

    Drop a file

    Drag in a STEP, GLB, FBX or OBJ file. STEP is converted first.

Windows
start.bat
macOS
./start.command
Command line
python step2glb.py input.step --meshopt

From 0.22.0 the app updates itself in Settings › Updates, and keeps the old version. Older versions need one manual update first. How updating works

Online or full app

Try it online. Download it for the rest.

The online version is the same app running in your browser, with nothing uploaded. It opens GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, 3MF and STL and has the same tools. The full app adds what a browser cannot do.

CAD files
STEP import, with parts, colours and CAD data.
Claude
The connection that lets Claude work with the open scene.
Folders
Open a folder, optimise many files in one go.
Big models
Large assemblies, without the browser running out of memory.
Your computer
Saved scenes, crash recovery, updates and offline use.

Requirements

What it needs.

Troubleshooting
Python
3.10, 3.11 or 3.12. Not 3.13 yet.
Browser
Chrome is best. Edge and Firefox work too. Safari on a Mac can lag.
Disk
About 2 GB for the first install.
Network
Not needed to run. A few rarely used converters download on demand.
